## Design checks — the 60-30-10 rules

- **Foundation** (60 %): neutral; its most colourful level stays at chroma ≤ 0.012 (+ rounding); neighbouring levels ΔL ≥ 0.02.
- **Band** (30 %): at least ΔL 0.1 from the foundation and, in coloured families, ΔC ≥ 0.06: connected, not fused.
- **Pop** (10 %): at least ΔE 0.15 from the band (a second colour, not a shade of the first); status colours ΔE ≥ 0.08 from the pop; urgent ΔE ≥ 0.15 from focused; pressed ΔE ≥ 0.03.
- **Colour share**: on a typical screen (60 % foundation, 30 % band, 10 % pop by area), how much of the *colour* (chroma × area) each part carries. A coloured theme whose foundation carries more than 25 % reads monotone.
